neighbours.label: ' and' or ' but' continuing a description of how something is ('were starched and', 'are mild, but', 'implausible and')
fire: His shoes were polished and fit well.
The terms are simple, but their effect is large.
The sets are cheap and pretty ugly.
This theory is implausible and plainly false.
The soup was hot and very salty.
Her tone is mild, but her meaning is clear.
The rooms are clean and fairly quiet.
His claim is weak and clearly wrong.
quiet: His shoes were in a box at home.
The terms are in Latin in the book.
The sets are shown in the film.
I saw Mark and Lucy at the fair.
Salt and vinegar are on the table.
Her tone is the same in the book.
The rooms are on the top floor.
Bread and butter are on the plate.

predictions: ' and'/' but' after a description fires; ' and' joining nouns stays quiet.
